description: This PHP class 'LDAPTestService' extends 'LDAPService' and provides functionality for testing LDAP connections and authentication using the Symfony LDAP component. It includes methods to get the LDAP adapter, test the connection, and test authentication, with logging of errors.

classes.name: LDAPTestService
classes.description: A service class for testing LDAP connections and authentication by extending LDAPService and utilizing Symfony LDAP components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LDAP setting.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Returns the LDAP adapter, instantiating it if necessary based on the LDAP setting.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Attempts to bind/connect to the LDAP server using provided credentials.

methods.name: testAuthentication
methods.description: Performs a test authentication by testing connection and catching exceptions to report success or failure.
